2020 Q3.bq: Third quarter revenue was $289 million, up 52% year-over-year and over $9 million above the high end of the guidance we provided in connection with the direct listing.

2020 Q4.bq: Fourth-quarter revenue was $322 million, up 40% year-over-year, and roughly $21 million above the high end of our prior guidance range.

2021 Q1.bq: Looking at our revenue performance, our total first quarter revenue growth was 49%, ahead of our prior guidance of 45%.

2021 Q2.bq: Drilling down into our second-quarter revenue, revenue growth was 49% ahead of our prior guidance of 43%.

2021 Q3.bq: Drilling down into our third quarter revenue, total revenue grew 36% year-over-year ahead of our prior guidance of 33%.

2022 Q1.bq: First quarter revenue grew 31% year-over-year, ahead of our prior guidance to $446 million.

2022 Q2.gq: For the third quarter, we expect revenue of between $474 million and $475 million and adjusted operating income of $54 million to $55 million.
2022 Q2.bq: Second quarter total revenue grew 26% year-over-year, ahead of our prior guidance to $473 million.

2022 Q3.gq: We are raising our outlook for adjusted income from operations for the full year.
2022 Q3.bq: Third quarter total revenue grew 22% year-over-year to $478 million, ahead of our prior guidance even when factoring in an additional $1. 4 million currency headwind since we issued guidance.

2023 Q1.bq: We generated $525 million in revenue in the first quarter of 2023, up 18% year-over-year, $20 million ahead of the midpoint of our prior guidance.

2023 Q2.bq: We generated $533 million in revenue, up 13% year-over-year and 2% sequentially, exceeding the high end of the range of our prior guidance.

2023 Q3.bq: Third quarter revenue reaccelerated to $558 million, up 17% year-over-year and 5% sequentially, exceeding the high end of the range of our prior guidance.

2023 Q4.bq: We beat the high end of our guidance range on both revenue and adjusted operating margin, driving an 800 basis point sequential increase to our Rule of 40 score, from 46% in the third quarter to 54% in the fourth quarter.

2024 Q3.gq: We're raising guidance for adjusted free cash flow to an excess of $1 billion for full year 2024.
2024 Q3.bq: Q3 was an exceptionally strong quarter, as revenue growth accelerated to 30% year-over-year, exceeding the high end of our prior guidance by nearly 450 basis points.

2025 Q3.bq: We also generated our highest ever reported revenue growth rate of 63% year over year, exceeding the high end of our prior guidance by 1,300 basis points and representing a 3,300 basis point increase compared to the growth rate in Q3 last year.

2025 Q4.bq: In the fourth quarter, we generated our highest-ever reported revenue growth rate of 70% year over year, exceeding the high end of our prior guidance by over 900 points and representing a 3,400 basis point increase compared to the growth rate in Q4 of last year.

2026 Q2.gq: For Q3 2026, we expect revenue of between $2.16 billion and $2.164 billion and adjusted income from operations of between $1.292 billion and $1.296 billion.
2026 Q2.bq: We're also raising our full year 2026 revenue guidance midpoint to $8.154 billion, representing 82% growth year-over-year and an 11-point increase over our full year 2026 revenue guidance from last quarter and our largest ever full year revenue guidance raise.

2026 Q3.gq: For Q4 2026, we expect revenue of between $2.649 billion and $2.653 billion, and adjusted income from operations of between $1.640 billion and $1.644 billion.
2026 Q3.bq: We are also raising our full year 2026 revenue guidance midpoint to $8.532 billion, representing 91% growth year-over-year, a 9-point increase over our full year 2026 revenue guidance from last quarter.
